sectionIntro: the work spans across disciplines and scales, from landscape and architecture to research-led spatial interventions. these collaborations bring together observation, design thinking and the realities of working with people, places and organisations

items.title: eme temple garden- a csr public space revamp
items.description: a landscape rejuvenation strategy for eme temple, reimagining its existing garden as a more accessible and inviting public environment. the proposal works with the character of the existing campus while introducing spaces for gathering, meditation, pause and everyday use.

items.title: the itinerant home
items.description: an installation exploring the transient nature of home through the lives and material practices of the kunchi kurve community. developed through neighbourhood documentation and multidisciplinary collaboration, the project translated their everyday relationship with work, movement, and dwelling into a spatial installation using found materials.

items.title: like a regular day - stories of a new economy in mumbai
items.description: a co-authored book emerging from urban studies, exploring mumbai’s changing social and economic fabric through the stories of people shaping its new economies. structured as a murder mystery, the narrative moves across the city through interconnected characters and locations, revealing the networks, work forms and everyday relationships that make up its contemporary urban life.

items.year: khar educational society · mumbai, india · 2018 to 2019
items.title: volunteer teacher
items.description: taught values-based lessons to children aged 4 to 7, using stories, activities and collaborative exercises to encourage critical thinking, teamwork, and reflection. worked alongside a diverse volunteer team to adapt lessons to different learning styles and create an engaging classroom environment.
